column1: # Skin-pigmentation benchmark variant set for AlphaGenome in-silico perturbation pipeline
# Curated from primary literature (see source_key -> references at bottom). Build: GRCh38/hg38 (AlphaGenome native).
# IMPORTANT: rsIDs are the stable identifiers. Confirm GRCh38 coordinates + window membership with annotate_benchmark.py.
# "expected_rnaseq_signal": VISIBLE   = acts via expression/splicing/accessibility -> POSITIVE control (pipeline SHOULD flag it)
#                           NULL_CODING = missense/LoF acting at protein level -> NEGATIVE control (pipeline SHOULD return ~null)
# control_class: POS = positive control ; NEG = negative control ; SUPP = supporting/region-level
